audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 4-5, 6 and two-plus items disagreed with the applied mirror, which sets row 1 to Skill, rows 3 and 4 to Ornn and row 6 to Skill.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 and 6 are where Bellows Breath's Brittle and Call of the Forge God arrive — they cannot be Volibear stages. At two items neither champion kills the other quickly, which is Skill, not an Ornn win.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side/win[1] to Skill, phases[3].side/win[3] and phases[4].side/win[4] to Ornn, phases[6].side/win[6] to Skill; level 6 rating dropped to 3/10 to mirror the raise on his page.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed level 6 as Volibear's dive spike and dismissed Call of the Forge God as 'a teamfight tool, not a 1v1 trade-winner'.
audit.why: The ult is summoned at 2500 range, slows, Brittles, and can be recast so Ornn charges into the elemental and redirects it. That reaches a diving Volibear from well outside the lane and it is exactly what answers the level-6 dive.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and phases[4].why now state the 2500-range summon, the recast redirect, and the 140s rank-1 timer as the window to dive on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (1) 'W shred' for Frenzied Maul again — W marks and applies on-hit, and it is the SECOND cast into the mark that heals. (2) The page never stated the combo that actually kills you: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar, and Searing Charge knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain — so he makes his own wall and knocks you into it.
audit.why: A player told only to 'sidestep the pillar' will dodge the fissure and then stand next to the terrain it just created, which is the setup, not the escape.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture: 800 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, slow plus a delayed magma pillar. Searing Charge: 450 range, 14s to 12s, knocks up on terrain collision — including his own pillar. Bellows Breath applies Brittle on the final gout, 12s to 10s. Frenzied Maul (5s) marks and applies on-hit; the re-cast into the mark heals.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E Riot text and cooldowns

audit.why: Every walk-up in this lane is timed off Volcanic Rupture; without its number 'when it is down' is unusable.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture's 8s rank-3 timer is now the stated walk-up window in spikes[0] and mid; Bellows Breath's 11s appears in phases[3].why.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Ornn has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but the moment you charge in he pillars with Q and knocks you up off it with E — walk in wide.

edits.before: Level 2 you keep the tempo edge with basic-ability pressure he can't match.
edits.after: Level 2 is even: he can pillar with Q and knock you up with E off it.

edits.before: Level 1 you beat a slow, farm-focused Ornn who has no early trading tool.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — his Q fissure slows from 800 before you can reach.

edits.before: At level 3 your Q stun and W shred out-trade him before W Bellows Breath charges.
edits.after: Level 3 is his — Bellows Breath leaves you Brittle and blunts your trade.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Ornn down every time Volcanic Rupture is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Bellows Breath leaves you Brittle every 11s at rank 3 — keep the trade short and leave.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you continue winning trades whenever you catch his slow W animation.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his — a Q pillar plus an E charge knocks you up for the combo.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Ornn under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables his tower, but Call of the Forge God comes from 2500 range and Brittles you — he answers the dive from anywhere.

edits.before: Your level 6 R lets you dive and burst him before his shield and armor matter.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Call of the Forge God slows and Brittles you from 2500.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Ornn can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items neither of you dies quickly: his passive stacks armour and MR while your Frenzied Maul re-bite refills you — win on objectives.

edits.before: With two-plus items Ornn's tank scaling, brittle shred, and ult take over the game.
edits.after: At 2+ items it evens out — he cannot kill you quickly and you cannot break him.

edits.before: You win early trades. Ornn's W Bellows Breath is his only real trading tool and it's slow — walk in with Q Thundering Smash stun and W Frenzied Maul before he can charge it, and back off before the brittle detonates. His Q Volcanic Rupture pillar is easy to sidestep.
edits.after: Ornn contests these levels. Bellows Breath makes you Brittle on the final gout, and a Q pillar with an E charge into it knocks you up. Walk in once Volcanic Rupture is spent — 8s at rank 3 — cash both Frenzied Maul bites, and leave before the combo reconnects.

edits.before: Your R Stormbringer lets you dive Ornn and burst him before his W shield and passive armor matter. His Call of the Forge God ult is a teamfight tool, not a 1v1 trade-winner, so keep pressuring him in lane.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables his tower, but Call of the Forge God summons the elemental from 2500 range and he can recast to charge into it and redirect it, slowing and Brittling you — dive only once that 140s ult is spent.

edits.before: Ornn is one of the best late-game tanks. His free item upgrades, W brittle shred, and double-cast Call of the Forge God make him nearly unkillable and a massive teamfight threat, and your DPS can no longer punch through his armor stacking.
edits.after: Ornn is a premier late tank: free item upgrades, Brittle from both W and R, and a recastable Call of the Forge God. You will not break him — but he cannot kill a drain-tank either, so take the sidelane and play objectives around him.

edits.before: Levels 3 through level 6 belong to you. Your Q stun plus W shred out-trade Ornn whenever you catch him before his Bellows Breath is charged, and at 6 your R lets you dive and burst him past his shield. Sidestep his Q pillar, punish his slow W, and build a lead while he's still soft.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 are contested, not free. Bellows Breath leaves you Brittle, and a Q pillar with an E charge into it knocks you up, so walk in wide of walls and only once Volcanic Rupture is on its 8s timer. Stun in, cash both Frenzied Maul bites for the heal, and step out before his combo reconnects.

edits.before: The matchup turns at first item and hard-flips by two-plus. Ornn's free item upgrades let him out-scale your gold, his W brittle shreds your resistances, and his double-cast ult makes him an unkillable teamfight anchor. Once he's stacked armor and health your damage can't break him, so your lead must be won before his items come online.
edits.after: The matchup turns at first item. Ornn's free upgrades out-scale your gold, Brittle blunts your resistances, and his recastable ult makes him a teamfight anchor. By two items neither of you dies fast: his passive keeps stacking armour and MR while your Frenzied Maul re-bite refills you. Win it on waves and objectives, not on duels you cannot finish.

edits.before: You spike levels 3-6 hard — that's the kill window. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Your windows are narrow and early; his run 4-5 through first item. See the level-by-level chart for the swings.

notes: The mirror flagged two prose strings on the Ornn page still calling Thundering Smash a 'dash' (Riot's text is 'gains speed towards enemies') — worth a later pass on ornn__volibear. The combo this page had never stated is Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar plus Searing Charge: his E knocks up on terrain collision, so he creates his own wall and knocks you into it. Sidestepping the fissure alone is not enough.
